Before you send your first voice message, please read how it works and what\'s allowed.
Voice messages only work between friends, and only after the other person agrees to receive them.
No harassment, hate, threats, sexual content or anything involving minors. Breaking these rules gets accounts banned.
Never share personal details: your address, phone number, passwords, school or workplace.
Your voice is personal. The other person can replay your message and could record it, so only send what you\'d be comfortable with others hearing.
To keep TalkLive friendly, voice messages are automatically transcribed and may be reviewed by our moderators.
If anything makes you uncomfortable, block or report the person from their profile.
